mapper.select: SELECT CONTENT_NO AS contentNo, TMDB_ID AS tmdbId, CONTENT_TYPE AS contentType, TITLE AS title, ORIGINAL_TITLE AS originalTitle, OVERVIEW AS overview, POSTER_PATH AS posterPath, BACKDROP_PATH AS backdropPath, RELEASE_DATE AS releaseDate, GENRE_TEXT AS genreText, RUNTIME AS runtime, EPISODE_COUNT AS episodeCount, DIRECTOR AS director, CAST_NAMES AS castNames, AGE_RATING AS ageRating, TMDB_SCORE AS tmdbScore, VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM CONTENT WHERE TMDB_ID = #{tmdbId} AND CONTENT_TYPE = #{contentType}

SELECT CONTENT_NO AS contentNo, TMDB_ID AS tmdbId, CONTENT_TYPE AS contentType, TITLE AS title, ORIGINAL_TITLE AS originalTitle, OVERVIEW AS overview, POSTER_PATH AS posterPath, BACKDROP_PATH AS backdropPath, RELEASE_DATE AS releaseDate, GENRE_TEXT AS genreText, RUNTIME AS runtime, EPISODE_COUNT AS episodeCount, DIRECTOR AS director, CAST_NAMES AS castNames, AGE_RATING AS ageRating, TMDB_SCORE AS tmdbScore, VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM CONTENT WHERE CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONTENT ( CONTENT_NO, TMDB_ID, CONTENT_TYPE, TITLE, ORIGINAL_TITLE, OVERVIEW, POSTER_PATH, BACKDROP_PATH, RELEASE_DATE, GENRE_TEXT, RUNTIME, EPISODE_COUNT, DIRECTOR, CAST_NAMES, AGE_RATING, TMDB_SCORE, VIEW_COUNT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_CONTENT_NO.NEXTVAL, #{tmdbId}, #{contentType}, #{title}, #{originalTitle, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{overview, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{posterPath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{backdropPath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{releaseDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{genreText, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{runtime, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{episodeCount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{director, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{castNames, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ageRating, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tmdbScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + 1, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo}
mapper.select: SELECT CONTENT_NO AS contentNo, TMDB_ID AS tmdbId, CONTENT_TYPE AS contentType, TITLE AS title, ORIGINAL_TITLE AS originalTitle, OVERVIEW AS overview, POSTER_PATH AS posterPath, BACKDROP_PATH AS backdropPath, RELEASE_DATE AS releaseDate, GENRE_TEXT AS genreText, RUNTIME AS runtime, EPISODE_COUNT AS episodeCount, DIRECTOR AS director, CAST_NAMES AS castNames, AGE_RATING AS ageRating, TMDB_SCORE AS tmdbScore, VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM CONTENT ORDER BY TMDB_SCORE DESC, VIEW_COUNT DESC FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY

SELECT * FROM CONTENT
ORDER BY
RELEASE_DATE DESC
VIEW_COUNT DESC
TMDB_SCORE DESC, VIEW_COUNT DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT A.ACTOR_NO AS actorNo, A.TMDB_ACTOR_ID AS tmdbActorId, A.ACTOR_NAME AS actorName, A.PROFILE_PATH AS profilePath, CA.CHARACTER_NAME AS characterName, CA.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder FROM CONTENT_ACTOR CA JOIN ACTOR A ON A.ACTOR_NO = CA.ACTOR_NO WHERE CA.CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo} ORDER BY CA.DISPLAY_ORDER, A.ACTOR_NO

SELECT D.DIRECTOR_NO AS directorNo, D.TMDB_DIRECTOR_ID AS tmdbDirectorId, D.DIRECTOR_NAME AS directorName, D.PROFILE_PATH AS profilePath, CD.DIRECTOR_TYPE AS directorType, CD.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder FROM CONTENT_DIRECTOR CD JOIN DIRECTOR D ON D.DIRECTOR_NO = CD.DIRECTOR_NO WHERE CD.CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo} ORDER BY CD.DISPLAY_ORDER, D.DIRECTOR_NO
